sparkline.description: Inline SVG trend line for a bound series of numbers, auto-scaled with an optional last-value label.

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: The bound numeric series: an array of numbers, or an object with a values array.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Caption shown next to the last value.

gauge.description: Semi-circular arc gauge for a single value against a min/max range.

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: The bound value: a number, or an object with a value field.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value to show. Wins over the binding.

attributes.name: unit
attributes.description: Suffix appended to the value, such as a percent sign.

status.description: A colored status dot next to a label: ok, warn, or down.

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: A bound state string, which overrides the state attribute.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: The state the dot shows. Anything else renders a neutral unknown dot.

uptime.description: Segmented bar showing a history of ok/warn/down states, oldest first.

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: The bound history: an array of ok, warn, or down strings, oldest first.

delta.description: An up or down triangle with a formatted change value.

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: The bound change: a number, or an object with a value field.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The change to show. Wins over the binding.

attributes.name: unit
attributes.description: Suffix appended to the value, such as a percent sign.
